Plate Enhancement Special Thanks: 70 Chocosteel + 30 Syrup Metal (09-23 to 10-08). New Region Exploration package (conditional, permanent from 10-08): 50 Chocosteel, 50 Syrup Metal, 30 pickup cookie cutters, 30 pickup pet tickets, 5× 8 h Lucky Dough idle, 5× 2 h Rune Crystal idle. Update package Vol.2 (10-08 to 10-22): 100 cutters, 100 pet tickets, 50 Chocosteel, 50 Syrup Metal, 3K Stellar Points, 10× 12 h XP idle, 5× 4 h Rune Crystal idle. Poster: buy all of the plate package under 10,000 KRW, the exploration package under 25,000, hold on Vol.2. Commenter's price guesses: 15,000 / 9,900 / 20,000 / 35,000; others think Vol.2 is 55,000.
